content: Render free web services: env vars set via Dashboard > Environment, or bulk-import from .env; default bind port is 10000 unless $PORT env var is used in start command. Health check path configured in Settings > Health Checks, must start with /, endpoint must return 2xx/3xx; recommended to check DB connectivity. Free tier: 750 instance-hours/workspace/month, spin-down after 15 min inactivity, ~1 min cold start on next request.
